Metadata.homeTitle: Batdongsan – Real Estate Discovery & Management Platform
Metadata.homeDescription: An online property discovery, listing, and internal MLS management platform for buyers, property owners, and real estate agents.
Metadata.loginDescription: Sign in to Batdongsan to manage your property listings, track saved properties, and connect transparently.
Metadata.registerDescription: Create a Batdongsan account for home buyers, property owners, and professional real estate agents.
Metadata.searchDescription: Search verified properties for sale and rent with transparent filters by location, property type, area, and price.
